assets.name: Earth globe with atmosphere, clouds and city lights
assets.description: Earth sphere using the shared NASA texture set: Blue Marble day map, Black Marble night lights, drifting cloud layer with soft shadows, ocean sun glint from a land mask, warm terminator and an additive atmospheric rim shell. Supports regional night-light outages for illustrative blackout shots.
assets.license: original_code; textures NASA public domain (see earth-textures-nasa-v1)
assets.notes: Radius 1 unit by default. Load textures once with loadEarthTextures(base). setView(lon, lat) turns a geographic point toward +Z; update(time_s) is linear in time. scatter scales the limb glow (1 = normal air). Added for ice-sank-instead-of-floating: optional seaIce texture (earth-seaice-mask-nasa-v1) and a seaIce 0..1 setter; default 0 leaves earlier videos unchanged.

assets.name: NASA Earth texture set (day, night lights, clouds, land mask)
assets.description: Equirectangular maps (longitude -180..180 left to right): day_8k.jpg (Blue Marble Next Generation, June 2004, topography + bathymetry), night_8k.jpg (Black Marble 2016), clouds_8k.jpg (Blue Marble clouds, grayscale), landmask_4k.png (land = white).
assets.notes: Built by scripts/build_earth_textures.py (py -3.14, numpy + Pillow) from asset-sources/raw. Credit requested by NASA: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA GSFC Blue Marble (R. Stockli), Black Marble 2016 (J. Stevens, M. Roman), land mask derived from GEBCO_08 via NASA EO. Provenance and hashes: asset-sources/sources.lock.json. A companion sea-ice mask now lives beside these files (see earth-seaice-mask-nasa-v1).

assets.name: Seeded starfield
assets.description: Point-sprite star shell with a power-law brightness distribution and blackbody-like tints; optional horizon cut-off for terrestrial night skies.
assets.notes: Static by design; call follow(camera) each frame. Sprite sizes are authored in pixels for 1080-wide output.

assets.name: Procedural flame billboard
assets.description: Additive teardrop flame shader on a Y-axis billboard with blue base, hot core and noise-driven sway. An intensity parameter shortens and fades it, so flames can be extinguished and reignited deterministically.
assets.notes: turbulence 0.1 = candle, 0.9 = campfire. Layer several with different seeds for a large fire. Outputs HDR values intended for bloom. Also used inside gas-burner-v1 for blue gas jets.

assets.name: Rising smoke ribbon
assets.description: Thin camera-facing smoke ribbon whose front climbs with age while noise curls it sideways; for snuffed candles, dying fires, chimneys and vents.
assets.notes: update(time_s, age_s, opacity, camera): age_s <= 0 hides it.

assets.name: Gradient sky dome with sun and haze
assets.description: Camera-centred gradient sky with sun disc, aureole and horizon haze. A scatter setter scales scattered skylight only, and toEnvironment() bakes a PMREM map so metals and clearcoat reflect the same sky.
assets.notes: Set sunIntensity and sunGlow to 0 for night or blue-hour skies. Pair the sun direction with a DirectionalLight.

assets.name: Open-water ocean surface
assets.description: Flat-plane ocean with analytic multi-octave travelling-wave normals, Fresnel sky reflection, sun glitter and distance haze. Suited to eye-level and aerial views of calm to moderate seas.
assets.notes: Keep horizon and zenith colours in step with the scene sky dome. No vertex displacement, so avoid extreme close-ups of the surface.

assets.name: Fractal mountain massif with altitude contour
assets.description: Seeded ridged-multifractal mountain that falls to sea level at its edges, vertex-coloured by altitude and slope (forest, rock, snow). setContour() draws a glowing iso-altitude line measured in real scene metres.
assets.notes: mesh.position.y is the base (sea) level. terrain.peak gives the summit in mesh-local coordinates for framing. Uses scene fog for aerial perspective.

assets.name: Cloud-top layer seen from above
assets.description: Large plane with domain-warped fractal cloud density, directional self-shadowing, gaps to a below colour and horizon haze; scroll offsets convey flight over the deck.
assets.notes: update(time_s, scrollX, scrollZ) in metres.

assets.name: Shallow underwater environment
assets.description: Complete shallow-sea set seen from below the surface: rippling Snell-window surface, camera-aligned sun shafts, caustic-lit sand and rocks, swaying seagrass, drifting particles and an optional bubble burst.
assets.notes: Surface at local y = 0. Exposes fogColor and fogDensity so other objects (for example fish-school-v1) can match the water. backdrop and surface meshes are now public so a stage can hide them above water or under an ice sheet. air-pressure-doubled guarded NaN-prone pow() calls in the shaft and caustic shaders and the floor normal. floorHeight(x, z) returns the exact sand height for seating props (e.g. corals); rockCount shows only the first N of the 16 seeded rocks without changing the random sequence.

assets.name: Instanced fish school
assets.description: Instanced silver fish with shader tail beat and countershading; each fish keeps a seeded offset around a moving school centre with slow wander.
assets.notes: update(time_s, center, heading): the caller supplies the school path, keeping this asset free of story timing. setSpread changes the school extents at runtime (for example to crowd the fish).

assets.name: Instanced flapping birds
assets.description: Gull-like instanced birds with two-segment wing flapping in the vertex shader, translucent wing lighting, and controllable sink and pitch for lift-loss or soaring shots.
assets.notes: Pass an analytic flap phase (integral of flap frequency) so rate changes stay smooth and deterministic. air-pressure-doubled added glide (0..1) to hold wings in a gliding pose; default 0 leaves earlier shots unchanged.

assets.name: Procedural articulated human figure
assets.description: Adult figure built from capsules and spheres with a joint hierarchy, standing and seated base poses, pose interpolation and two-bone arm IK (reachArm). Intended for respectful mid-distance, back-view and silhouette shots.
assets.notes: Faces +Z, origin at the feet. Stylised: avoid facial close-ups. Exposes head, chestAnchor and hand anchors for effects. air-pressure-doubled added empty gear anchors (back, waist, feet) and a guard in reachArm for a pole parallel to the reach direction (previously NaN).

assets.name: Unbranded twin-engine airliner with contrails
assets.description: Procedural narrow-body airliner (lathe fuselage with window band, swept wings, winglets, tail, nacelles, exhaust glow, navigation lights). Contrail ribbons are gated by emission time so an engine cut leaves a physically consistent gap.
assets.notes: Flies toward local -Z. Add both group and contrailGroup to the scene; contrails stay level while the aircraft pitches or sinks. No real airline livery.

assets.name: Kinetic burned-in captions
assets.description: Word-timed caption renderer for a 2D canvas: clause-aware phrase splitting, two balanced lines, active-word accent and accent_color / gentle_scale / subtle_glow emphasis, outline, shadow and a soft backdrop band.
assets.notes: Feed it word timings from tools/narrate.mjs (real synthesized audio aligned with local Whisper), never guessed timings. cues() returns the displayed phrases and their times; tools/transcript.mjs uses it so output SRT/TXT files match the burned-in captions. Optional pill backdrop; default band behavior is preserved.

assets.name: Deterministic film render pipeline
assets.description: Storyboard-driven frame renderer: shot lookup, keyframe cameras, HDR MSAA scene buffer, bloom, ACES grade, vignette, deterministic grain, cross-dissolves, 2D label overlay and caption compositing. renderFrame(i) depends only on i.
assets.notes: Workflow for a new story: add src/stories/<slug>/film.ts (createFilm) and register it in src/entry.ts; then run node tools/narrate.mjs stories/<slug>.json, node tools/soundtrack.mjs <slug>, node tools/render.mjs <slug> --frames a,b,c for smoke frames and --final for the MP4. ffmpeg and ffprobe come from the ffmpeg-static and ffprobe-static npm packages. air-pressure-doubled added a sanitize pass before bloom that zeroes NaN/Inf scene pixels so a single bad pixel cannot bloom into a black block; valid pixels are unchanged. renderFrame(i, { overlay: false, captions: false }) renders a clean still (used for thumbnails); defaults keep normal rendering unchanged.

assets.name: Storyboard keyframe camera rig
assets.description: Applies storyboard camera keyframes (position, look_at, ease, FOV) to a perspective camera at any absolute time, clamping outside the span so shots can be evaluated early or late for dissolves.
assets.notes: For smooth pans between a near and a far subject, author look_at points at similar distances along the line of sight.

assets.name: Schematic label and callout helpers
assets.description: 2D canvas helpers for SCHEMATIC / ILLUSTRATIVE tags, status chips, leader-line callouts that flip to stay inside the frame, and rich text with numeric subscripts (O_2 style).
assets.notes: Use projectToScreen() from film-pipeline-v1 to anchor labels to 3D points.

assets.name: Procedural audio synthesis kit
assets.description: Pure-JS deterministic audio toolkit: detuned additive pads, white/pink/brown noise, RBJ biquads with sweeps, Freeverb-style reverb, crackle generator, envelopes and stereo mix helpers for original music beds and sound effects.
assets.notes: Story cues live in src/stories/<slug>/soundtrack.mjs (export buildSoundtrack(duration) returning {music, sfx}); tools/soundtrack.mjs mixes them under the narration and loudness-normalises to the storyboard target.

assets.name: Shared shader noise and deterministic math
assets.description: GLSL value-noise and fbm chunks plus a fog helper (glsl.ts), with seeded RNG, value noise, fbm, ridged multifractal, easing and wobble helpers (math.ts) used by every library component.
assets.notes: Companion file: src/library/util/math.ts.

assets.name: Inter typeface (Medium, SemiBold, Bold)
assets.description: Latin subsets of Inter at weights 500, 600 and 700 for captions and labels.
assets.notes: Inter by Rasmus Andersson, copied from the @fontsource/inter npm package; licence text in assets/library/fonts/Inter-OFL.txt. Glyphs outside the Latin subset fall back to the system font. Inter Black (900) and Black Italic (900 italic) were added from the same @fontsource/inter package (OFL-1.1) as assets/library/fonts/Inter-Black.woff2 and Inter-BlackItalic.woff2 for bold thumbnail covers.

assets.name: Glass of water with ice cubes
assets.description: Tumbler with a transmissive glass shell and water volume, a visible waterline, frosted ice cubes and small bubbles. A single sink value moves the cubes between floating (about a tenth above the waterline) and resting on the bottom, staggered per cube.
assets.notes: Units are metres. Needs scene.environment (for example sky-dome-v1 toEnvironment) for convincing reflections; glass and water use three.js physical transmission, so objects behind them must be opaque to appear refracted. setWaterLevel(level), added for rain-nonstop-everywhere, rebuilds the water to the glass taper for filling or draining shots; radius = baseRadius gives a straight measuring cylinder.

assets.name: Schematic water molecules: liquid to ice lattice
assets.description: Instanced H2O molecules that morph between a jostling liquid and an open hexagonal ice lattice with hydrogen-bond lines. The liquid arrangement occupies about 9% less volume, matching real water.
assets.notes: Always label as schematic and not to scale. halfSize gives the ice-state bounding box for outline boxes; view down +Z to reveal the hexagons.

assets.name: Floating ice sheet (top and underside)
assets.description: Lake or sea ice lid with a snow-dusted, cracked, reflective top surface and a softly glowing underside whose brightness follows snow cover, cracks and trapped bubbles. A moving soft shadow can be projected onto the underside.
assets.notes: Top surface at local y = 0. The custom shader does not receive shadow maps; add a blob shadow mesh for figures standing on it. Pair the underside with underwater-volume-v1 (hide that asset's own surface).

assets.name: Wrapped particle fall (snow or sinking crystals)
assets.description: Stateless wrapped particle fall for snow in air or ice crystals sinking through water, with optional tumbling glints and an amount control to start or stop the fall on cue.
assets.notes: Move points.position to keep the volume around the camera. Sprite sizes are authored for 1080-wide output. A negative fallSpeed makes particles rise (used as illustrative evaporation over the sea in rain-nonstop-everywhere).

assets.name: Instanced conifers with snow load
assets.description: Instanced stylised conifers (tiered cones on a trunk) with snow painted on upward-facing outer surfaces, plus a seeded scatter helper.
assets.notes: Mid-ground and background use; tree shapes are simple, so keep them beyond about 30 m from the camera.

assets.name: Sea-ice floes, fast-ice platform and tabular iceberg
assets.description: Irregular snow-topped floes with blue-green flanks, an optional flat fast-ice platform and an optional tabular iceberg, all authored around a waterline at y = 0 with about a tenth of the ice above it.
assets.notes: Use over ocean-surface-v1. update(time_s, sink) lowers pieces with staggered delays for melting or counterfactual shots.

assets.name: Emperor penguin colony
assets.description: Instanced vertex-coloured emperor penguins (adults with yellow ear patches, grey downy chicks beside them) with a gentle deterministic sway and shuffle.
assets.notes: Stand the group on a flat surface at its local y = 0. Designed for mid-distance shots (birds about 100–250 px tall).

assets.name: Soft bokeh light discs
assets.description: Field of edge-bright out-of-focus discs for macro, interior and night-city backgrounds, with a dim control that switches discs off in seeded order.
assets.notes: Additive; keep gain low over bright backdrops. Disc size is in pixels for 1080-wide output.

assets.name: NASA-derived floating sea-ice mask
assets.description: Equirectangular 4096x2048 mask (white = sea ice floating on ocean, land masked out) derived from NASA Blue Marble 2002 land/ocean/ice imagery, for the seaIce parameter of earth-globe-v1.
assets.notes: Built by py -3.14 scripts/build_earth_textures.py --only seaice. Credit: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, Blue Marble 2002 (R. Stockli). Load with loadEarthTextures(base, anisotropy, { seaIce: true }).

assets.name: Crumpling plastic bottle
assets.description: Clear PET bottle (ribbed lathe shell with physical transmission, ribbed screw cap, optional label band). A crumple value caves the walls in along seeded concave faces, crossing folds and wrinkles until the inside volume is roughly halved, as a sealed bottle would under one extra atmosphere; base, neck and cap stay rigid.
assets.notes: Deformation and normals are computed in the vertex shader from the crumple value alone (values slightly above 1 give an overshoot). Negative crumple values are not supported; to show a bottle swelling at altitude, add a separate parameter rather than reusing crumple.

assets.name: Analog dial gauge
assets.description: Barometer / thermometer / pressure gauge with a canvas-drawn face (ticks, labels, unit, title, coloured marks), brass, steel or black bezel, glass cover, tapered needle and an optional probe stem. Face points along +Z.
assets.notes: value is a plain setter, so drive it from a deterministic function of time. Clockwise = increasing, scale centred on 12 o'clock.

assets.name: Schematic air molecules
assets.description: Instanced schematic gas sample: N2 and O2 dumbbells, argon atoms and O=C=O molecules filling a box from seeded stratified slots, with thermal jitter and spin. A density control shows density x count molecules, popping extra molecules in at empty slots so a doubling reads as the same space holding twice as many.
assets.notes: Always label as schematic: molecules are enlarged and far sparser than real air. Composition defaults to real dry-air number fractions.

assets.name: Cooking pot with boiling water
assets.description: Brushed stainless pot with riveted handles and water: transmissive surface with ripples and boiling bumps, and a stateless bubble pool (small nucleation streams, then large rolling-boil bubbles) controlled by a boil value.
assets.notes: boil: 0 still, ~0.2 a few bubbles, 1 rolling boil. Pair with smoke-wisp-v1 for steam and gas-burner-v1 underneath. Needs a reasonably bright environment map for the steel to read as stainless.

assets.name: Gas hob burner
assets.description: Domestic gas burner: enamel cap, aluminium head, four-arm cast-iron grate and a ring of small blue flame jets built on flame-v1, each billboarding about its own jet axis toward the camera, plus a soft blue point light.
assets.notes: Origin at the hob surface; grateTop gives the height a pot sits at. intensity 0 shows a cold burner.

assets.name: Wind-bent grass field
assets.description: Instanced grass blades over any ground function with a rejection test, bent along a circular arc by a force-proportional wind bend, travelling gusts and flutter; wrap and back-light shading, flower-tipped blades, distance fog and a relight setter for other times of day.
assets.notes: Doubling wind.bend shows a wind that pushes twice as hard (small-angle approximation). Grass does not receive shadows; the ground under it does. growth 0..1 (default 1), added for rain-nonstop-everywhere, raises blades in a staggered order for sprouting time-lapses; a noise-based reject gives sparse tufts.

assets.name: Sailboat (sloop)
assets.description: Small sloop: vertex-coloured hull with boot stripe and antifouling, deck and cabin, mast, boom, cambered mainsail and jib (or furled with a sail cover for moored boats), stays, heel and a seeded bob.
assets.notes: Local frame: bow +X, mast +Y, waterline y = 0, sails eased toward -Z (wind from +Z); positive heel leans toward -Z. Built for mid and far distances.

assets.name: Scuba gear for the humanoid
assets.description: Diving kit that attaches to humanoid-figure-v1 anchors: aluminium tank with valve, buoyancy jacket and straps, weight belt, mask with glass, regulator with hose, and fins with foot pockets that continue the shin line (the figure's shoes are hidden).
assets.notes: Rotate the figure root horizontal (e.g. Euler YXZ (pi/2, yaw, 0)) for swimming; regulatorWorld() feeds bubble-stream-v1. The hose is approximate for small head turns.

assets.name: Exhalation bubble stream
assets.description: Periodic bursts of bubbles from an emitter that wobble, spread, accelerate gently and swell by Boyle's law as the water pressure falls toward the surface; placed statelessly from the burst schedule.
assets.notes: surfacePressure is in atmospheres (1 = today, 2 = doubled air) and only affects the Boyle growth factor.

assets.name: Procedural rocky and icy Moon
assets.description: Seeded near-side lunar maria, cratered ice, moving frost front, albedo-controlled lighting and earthshine for Moon and icy-satellite stories.
assets.notes: Rock and ice maps are generated from seeded canvas textures; visual geography is illustrative. Use a label when showing a material transformation.

assets.name: Schematic tidal-potential contours
assets.description: Colored contours around a planet for multiple tide-raising bodies, with amplitude and direction controls.
assets.notes: Diagram contours are exaggerated and distances are not to scale; label accordingly.

assets.name: Procedural intertidal estuary
assets.description: Seeded mudflat heightfield with branching channels, marsh tufts, and a clipped water sheet controlled by tide level.
assets.notes: Illustrative local topography; low tide is a smaller tideLevel value.

assets.name: Deep ocean cross-section
assets.description: Layered ocean slice with a ridge, directional current arrows, and seeded deterministic mixing particles.
assets.notes: Visual vertical scale is exaggerated; currents and particles represent mixing conceptually.

assets.name: Walking dung beetle
assets.description: Procedural scarab with articulated gait, glossy chitin, and a rolling fibrous ball.
assets.notes: Designed for cinematic macro views; gait is illustrative.

assets.name: Rain streaks, splash rings and rain shafts
assets.description: Deterministic rain kit. Rain: instanced camera-facing streaks stretched along each drop's velocity, fixed in world space and recycled in a box around the camera; intensity reveals anything from a few drops to a steady fall. RainSplashes: expanding splash rings on puddles, a glass of water or a wet table. RainShaft: soft distant rain curtains hanging from a cloud base.
configurable_parameters: RainSplashes: size|radius, cell, period, life, ringScale, lineWidth, color, opacity, seed, intensity
RainShaft: width, height, color, opacity, fallSpeed, seed
assets.notes: Call update(time_s, camera) every frame; positions are a pure function of time. The streak material is double-sided because the quad's screen winding flips with the fall direction. For readable drizzle at 1080×1920 use width ≈ 2 mm, opacity ≈ 0.45, fallSpeed ≈ 4 m/s, streakLength ≈ 0.25 m; heavier rain: more drops, longer streaks.

assets.name: Procedural sand dune sea
assets.description: Seeded heightfield of asymmetric transverse dunes (gentle windward slopes, steep slip faces) with shader wind ripples and close-up sand grains. wetness turns on raindrop spots that merge into dark, glossy soaked sand; greening spreads patchy vegetation tint from the interdune hollows. heightAt(x, z) returns the mesh height for cameras and props.
assets.notes: flatRadius keeps a flat y = 0 area around the origin for macro shots; dunes reach full height beyond about 2.6 × flatRadius. Built on MeshStandardMaterial (onBeforeCompile), so scene lights and fog apply. On Intel/ANGLE, grazing macro shots have poor depth precision: keep camera near ≥ 1 cm and draw decals on the sand in the opaque pass without a depth test.

assets.name: Overcast cloud base seen from below
assets.description: Large horizontal plane at the cloud-base altitude with warped fractal density: dark where thick, bright where thin, a silver lining toward the sun and haze toward the horizon. coverage opens gaps onto the sky dome; setGap clears a soft, sunlit break at a world position.
assets.notes: Pair with sky-dome-v1: gaps and the far haze reveal the dome. Transparent with renderOrder -50; give the camera a far plane that covers the cloud distance you want to see.

assets.name: Planet-wide cloud shell
assets.description: Sphere of slowly drifting fractal cloud for planets: coverage grows from scattered patches to one unbroken overcast deck, sunlit with billow shading on the day side and dark at night.
assets.notes: Add to the planet group at about 1.006–1.01 × the planet radius. With earth-globe-v1, raise Earth.scatter as coverage grows so the blue limb still reads as Earth.

assets.name: Ground-mounted solar panel array
assets.description: Rows of tilted photovoltaic panels with a canvas-drawn cell grid (silver busbars on dark blue cells), clearcoat glass, aluminium frames, rails and steel posts. wetness makes the glass glossier so it mirrors the sky.
assets.notes: The group origin is the centre of the array on the ground and panels face +Z. Give the scene an environment map (for example SkyDome.toEnvironment) for convincing reflections.

assets.name: Thumbnail cover composer (bold or clean)
assets.description: Video thumbnails and covers drawn over a clean film still. Bold (default): punch-in on the subject with a punchier grade and vignette, huge tilted Inter Black capitals with a heavy outline and hard shadow, yellow highlight words, a red sticker and a yellow arrow to the subject. Clean: calm centred headline title card with an accent bar. Text stays inside the band that survives grid crops and app buttons.
configurable_parameters: palette: text, highlight, badge, badge_text, arrow
assets.notes: composeBoldThumbnail (default) and drawThumbnailTitle (style "clean") in the same module. src/entry.ts renderThumbnail() feeds the storyboard thumbnail block (badge_at -> badgeAt) over FilmPipeline.renderFrame(i, { overlay: false, captions: false }); tools/render.mjs writes output/<slug>.jpg after --final, or alone with --thumbnail. Long sticker text shrinks to about 64% of the width. Bold style needs Inter 900 / 900 italic (font-inter-v1). Style varies per video: font from THUMB_FONTS (font-display-set-v1), colour grade from THUMB_GRADES, palette colours and tilt.

assets.name: Display fonts for thumbnails
assets.description: Six license-cleared display faces for thumbnail headlines, chosen per niche: Anton (condensed impact), Bebas Neue (condensed cinematic), Archivo Black (wide heavy), Bangers (comic), Orbitron 900 (sci-fi) and Playfair Display 900 (serif). Latin-subset WOFF2 files with their OFL texts; FONTS.md maps each to its thumbnail.font key and best uses.
configurable_parameters: thumbnail.font: inter | anton | bebas-neue | archivo-black | bangers | orbitron | playfair
assets.notes: Copied unmodified from the @fontsource/* 5.3.0 npm packages (Playfair Display has a Reserved Font Name, so keep it unmodified). Loaded by src/entry.ts; metrics (tracking, line height, outline) live in THUMB_FONTS in src/library/overlay/Thumbnail.ts.

assets.name: Detailed city street and aerial district
assets.description: Metre-scale street with procedural masonry and room-interior facade textures, warm shopfronts, granite paving, zebra crossing, wet asphalt and light streaks, practical street lamps, pedestrian signals, unbranded vehicles and an instanced surrounding city district. Static near geometry is combined by material for efficient frame capture.
assets.notes: All textures are generated by original Canvas code; no external branding or media. Road runs along Z, crossing at origin; facades start at X = plus/minus (roadWidth/2 + sidewalkWidth). Windows and lamps remain on unless lights explicitly changes. Wet-road effects use material response and authored reflection streaks, not a full ray-traced reflection. makeCityCar is exported for unbranded background vehicles. Validated in local Chrome WebGL smoke captures (opening, dissolve, survivors, aerial, memorial and repair crew); no shader errors. The detailed implementation described here is kept verbatim as src/library/environment/CityStreetClassic.ts (CityStreetClassic, makeClassicCityCar) since CityStreet.ts was rewritten to a simpler hazard kit; this.far.children[0] is the instanced skyline (one box per instance) for corridor edits.

assets.name: Deterministic articulated pedestrian crossing
assets.description: Crowd built from the registered Humanoid rig with seeded overlapping heights and skin/clothing palettes, children, umbrellas, backpacks, opposite crossing directions, analytic gait, deceleration and head turns. Optional per-figure flags invoke the reusable dissolve effect and analytic prop drops.
assets.notes: Uses humanoid-figure-v1 and vanish-dissolve-v1. Every pose and path is evaluated from absolute caller time; passing identical clock/state reproduces the opening configuration. Figures are intended for respectful medium views and silhouettes, not facial closeups. Validated in local Chrome WebGL smoke captures (opening, dissolve, survivors, aerial, memorial and repair crew); no shader errors. For close views of umbrellas, set umbrellaCount: 0, attach makeUmbrella() to each figure root and hold it with Humanoid.reachArm after update(); pass clock_s from the shot start to keep the seeded spacing.

assets.name: Deterministic material erosion and sideways motes
assets.description: Material modifier that clones source materials and adds reversible world-space threshold erosion with a soft emissive rim. Seeded short-lived motes drift along a configurable vector without an automatic upward bias.
assets.notes: Attach motes separately beside the source object. update(time_s,start_s,origin,enabled) returns progress. Cloned MeshStandardMaterial programs share one shader cache key at the default material configuration. All temporal state is supplied by the caller. Validated in local Chrome WebGL smoke captures (opening, dissolve, survivors, aerial, memorial and repair crew); no shader errors.

assets.description: Procedural container stacks, cranes, yard lights and working waterfront scenery.
assets.notes: Original procedural code. Rendered in the 75-second Three.js film and inspected in representative WebGL frames.

assets.notes: Original procedural code. Rendered in the 75-second Three.js film and inspected in representative WebGL frames. balconies=false omits foreground balcony rails; default true preserves existing films.

assets.notes: Original procedural code. Rendered in the 75-second Three.js film and inspected in representative WebGL frames.

assets.description: Close-view articulated newborn palm and digits with soft skin and nail details.
assets.notes: Original procedural code. Rendered in the 75-second Three.js film and inspected in representative WebGL frames.

assets.description: Reusable geometry, rod, material and CanvasTexture helpers for architecture and props.
assets.notes: Original procedural code. Rendered in the 75-second Three.js film and inspected in representative WebGL frames.

assets.name: UN WPP 2024 world population graphics data
assets.description: World historical totals and 2026 age-by-sex bars extracted from UN WPP 2024; five-year groups divided evenly for schematic single-year bars; future retention is an explicitly illustrative scenario.
assets.license: UN WPP 2024; CC BY 3.0 IGO; attribution required
assets.notes: UN DESA Population Division, World Population Prospects 2024, https://population.un.org/wpp/ . The age bars are schematic and future retention is illustrative.

assets.name: Plate-drift Earth (continents as moving plates)
assets.description: Earth whose continents are separate plates: each plate is the NASA day map cut by the land mask inside lon/lat boxes, drawn on its own sphere layer and rotated rigidly about an Euler pole from today's map (progress 0) to a target arrangement (progress 1). Ocean sphere with sun glint and atmosphere rim, optional glowing mid-ocean ridge, and two schematic overlays measured on the sphere: a dry interior and a hot glow. Ships PANGAEA_PLATES (a Pangaea-like fit with Africa and Eurasia fixed), MID_ATLANTIC_RIDGE and geoDir().
configurable_parameters: plates (name, boxes{lon, lat, ragged}, pole + angle or from/to/spin)
assets.notes: Needs earth-textures-nasa-v1 (day map and land mask). PANGAEA_PLATES poles were fitted to matched coastlines and refined on the land mask for snug seams with little overlap; the arrangement is schematic, not a reconstruction. Boxes with ragged > 0 cut land along a noisy edge so a departing plate leaves a natural coastline (fixed land and plates still tile exactly). For close views set sunDirection every frame from the camera (key light behind and above the camera) and lower glint to about 0.25. pointOn() gives world positions for labels and camera targets on a moving plate.

assets.name: Procedural coral heads
assets.description: Shallow-reef coral heads in three procedural forms (grooved brain coral, branching fans, table corals on stems), instanced with seeded positions, sizes, rotations and a warm reef palette; matte so they read under caustics and underwater fog.
assets.notes: Static; add group to the scene. With underwater-volume-v1 pass ground: (x, z) => sea.floorHeight(x, z) so every coral sits on the sand; use reject to keep sand channels open. MeshStandardMaterial with instance colours, so scene lights and FogExp2 apply.

assets.name: Village of small gabled houses
assets.description: Seeded houses at given sites and headings: walls in a pastel palette, overhanging gabled roofs, doors, lit and dark windows, optional stilts, merged into four draw calls. glow scales the window light for dusk, storms or lightning.
assets.notes: Yaw 0 faces +Z (−π/2 faces −X). Windows are unlit emissive quads that still take scene fog, so lit windows glow through rain haze; read best from 15–80 m. Pair with pedestrian-crowd-v1 for inhabited scenes.

assets.name: Planet cutaway (layered interior)
assets.description: Planet with a quarter wedge (object-space x > 0, z > 0) cut to the centre: a lit textured surface shell with an atmosphere halo, plus two flat cut faces that draw the layers at true radii: thin crust, mantle (mottled, with optional animated convection loops), molten outer core (domain-warped flow) and a crystalline inner core. A freezing front can turn the outer core into dark crystalline metal still glowing red along the grain boundaries.
assets.notes: Defaults are Earth's layer radii (inner core 1,221 km, core–mantle boundary 3,480 km, crust ~35 km). Rotate `group` to aim the wedge; place the camera in the removed quadrant (e.g. direction (1, 0.4, 1)) to see both faces. spin turns the surface map while the cut stays put. Use pointOn() with a point on a face (x = 0 or z = 0 in the cutaway frame) to anchor labels. Pair with magnetic-field-lines-v1 for dynamo stories.

assets.name: Dipole magnetic field lines
assets.description: Schematic dipole magnetic field around a planet: lines r = L·R·sin²θ from pole to pole as thin additive tubes with pulses flowing along them. strength fades the field with the outer shells going first; loops seen edge-on fade so they never cut a straight streak across the planet.
assets.notes: Add next to (not inside) the planet so it does not spin with the surface. 4 shells × 8 lines reads cleanly at 1080×1920; more becomes hairy. Label as schematic: real field lines are invisible and extend much farther.

assets.name: Solar-wind particle stream
assets.description: Schematic solar-wind streaks flowing along +X past a planet at the origin. shield = 1 bends the stream around a paraboloid magnetopause; shield = 0 lets it strike the upper atmosphere with a brief flash. escape grows a faint plume of ions leaving the night side.
assets.notes: Rotate or position `group` so +X points away from the Sun. Frame wide (planet ~45% of the width) so both the incoming stream and the plume show. Particles and plume are vastly exaggerated: label as schematic.

assets.name: Aurora curtains
assets.description: Rippling aurora curtains for night skies: folded ribbons with a sharp, bright green lower edge, vertical rays and a pink upper fringe, additive and waving over time; intensity fades them.
assets.notes: Place far away and large (kilometres) so parallax reads as sky-high; give the camera a far plane beyond the curtains. Pair with sky-dome-v1 night colours, starfield-v1 and conifer-stand-v1; tint a hemisphere light green with the intensity for light on snow.

assets.name: Brass pocket compass
assets.description: Brass pocket compass: lathe-turned case and bezel, bow ring, printed rose card (degree ticks, cardinal letters, eight-point star), glass cover and a two-tone diamond needle on a pivot. heading turns the needle.
assets.notes: Card lies in the XZ plane facing +Y with north toward −Z; heading is clockwise seen from above. Give the scene an environment map (e.g. PMREM of RoomEnvironment, intensity ~0.3) or the brass renders black.

assets.name: Erupting volcano
assets.description: Procedural volcanic cone: noise-carved basalt with radial gullies and a summit crater, emissive lava flows with pulses moving downhill, a glowing crater, ballistic lava fountains and a billowing ash plume lit orange from below.
assets.notes: Reads best at blue hour or night where the lava is the main light; aim a long channel at the camera (channels uses atan2(z, x) angles). Keep cameras above heightAt(x, z) + ~40 m. Units are metres (cone ~1.2 km by default).

assets.name: Procedural rocky planet (Mars-like)
assets.description: Procedural rocky planet, Mars-like by default: seamless 3D-noise terrain colours, dark plains, crater bowls with bright rims, polar caps and a thin haze rim, lit by one sun; no textures needed.
assets.notes: Spin via group.rotation. Change palette/capSize/atmosphere for other worlds (e.g. grey airless moons, icy exoplanets). Pair with solar-wind-stream-v1 for atmosphere-loss scenes.

assets.name: Solar orbital geometry and Kepler race
assets.description: Configurable orbital tracks, comparison markers, reference annulus and procedural solar beacon. Marker periods follow Kepler’s third law. All lengths are diagram units.
assets.notes: Annulus is a user-defined reference band, not a computed habitable-zone boundary. Label schematic and not to scale.

assets.name: Water photolysis and hydrogen escape diagram
assets.description: Bent water molecules dissociate into hydroxyl and hydrogen; a UV ray and deterministic escape trajectory explain net upper-atmosphere chemistry.
assets.notes: Simplified H2O + photon -> OH + H schematic. Trajectories are explanatory, not a molecular dynamics or escape-rate simulation.

assets.name: PBR desiccating soil
assets.description: Procedural Voronoi soil polygons with desiccation cracks, fine grain and reversible moisture-to-dry color control.
assets.notes: Deterministic original procedural material on a metre-scale ground plane; editable resolution-independent shader detail.

assets.name: Synchronized Jump Motion
assets.description: Analytic crouch, ballistic leap and landing driver for existing humanoid rigs.
assets.notes: Original parameterised Three.js code validated in Chrome WebGL storyboard frame captures. All motion is evaluated from caller time. Crowd silhouettes are for mid-distance/aerial use. Recoil display displacement is independently exaggerated and requires a schematic label; mass ratio is used only for the physical displacement calculation.

assets.name: Center Of Mass Recoil Diagram
assets.description: Parameterised two-body recoil apparatus with a fixed center-of-mass crosshair.
assets.notes: Original parameterised Three.js code validated in Chrome WebGL storyboard frame captures. All motion is evaluated from caller time. Crowd silhouettes are for mid-distance/aerial use. Recoil display displacement is independently exaggerated and requires a schematic label; mass ratio is used only for the physical displacement calculation.

assets.description: Generic storage tank, manifold and metal tap for public water-service scenes.

assets.name: 3D tactical metropolitan damage & survival radius map
assets.description: Dark-mode satellite street grid with winding river channel, concentric color-coded blast/gravity/thermal radius rings (e.g. 0.5 MI, 2 MI, 10 MI, 50 MI), pulsing epicenter pin, radar shockwave sweep, and ringPointWorld() helper for anchoring overlay-labels-v1 callouts.
assets.notes: Pair with overlay-labels-v1 drawCallout() using projectToScreen(map.ringPointWorld(i, deg)) and ask 'Where would you be on the map?' to drive comment velocity.

assets.name: Procedural multi-band planetary ring system with shadow cutout
assets.description: Multi-band concentric ring disc with Cassini and Encke divisions, ice/rock radial color gradient, and real-time planetary shadow cylinder cutout on the anti-solar side.
assets.notes: Attach to earth-globe-v1 group for orbital views, or position in world space above sky-dome-v1 for ground-level ring-arch and shadow-winter views.

assets.name: Deterministic singularity / vortex debris accretion rig
assets.description: Event-horizon core with relativistic photon ring and instanced urban/terrain debris chunks that lift and spiral inward in staggered distance order.
assets.notes: Pair with city-street-block-v1 (carLiftProgress, roofLiftProgress) and pedestrian-crowd-v1 (vortexPull) for sequential urban accretion.

assets.name: Altitude-aware scattering sky and planet backdrop
assets.description: Camera-centred dome that marches single scattering (Rayleigh 8 km, Mie 1.2 km, ozone layer at 25 km, plus a multiple-scattering term) per pixel from the true camera altitude, so the same component gives a blue street sky, an indigo 19 km sky, a black noon sky above 30 km and the glowing limb from orbit. Rays that hit the planet shade the real NASA day map by latitude/longitude around a chosen site under a cloud shell from the NASA cloud map. ATMOSPHERE_GLSL exports the same functions (sun transmittance, in-scatter march with a cloud split, cloud and ground shading) so solid objects get matching aerial perspective and cloud occlusion.
configurable_parameters: uWeather (storm, lee clearing, desert tint, flow speed)
uCloudSea (procedural cloud sea, radius, obstacle radius, lightning)
assets.notes: Site frame is x east, y up, z south in km with the planet centre at (0, -R, 0); stage world axes must stay parallel to it (uniform scale/offset is fine). Give the true camera km every frame (GiantPeak.setCamera does this). Single scattering makes skies darker than surfaces: uSkyGain 1.5-2.3 brightens the dome only. Uses earth-textures-nasa-v1 (day + clouds via loadDayAndClouds). Stars need a depth-only planet sphere to stay above the horizon. Validated in local Chrome WebGL (Intel Iris Xe) from 1.6 m to 120 km altitude.

assets.name: Planetary-scale mountain (km, curved planet)
assets.description: 100 km-class mountain built in true kilometres on a 6,371 km sphere: concave polar mesh (340 x 1080) with radial ridge spurs, fractal detail and summit crags; altitude-zoned material (forest, alpine rock, a snow belt that stops at the top of the weather, bare stratified rock to the summit) shaded with the atmosphere-scatter-sky-v1 functions for matching haze, sunlight colour, cloud-shell occlusion and horizon hiding. Uniform controls for growth, gravitational slump/spread/isostatic sink, ten glowing altitude bands, a tinted hazard zone with hatching, base fracture glow, a z-cut clip, a hole for metre-scale foreground patches and optional logarithmic depth. PeakCutaway adds the matching z = 0 cross-section with an overburden-stress heat map (26.5 MPa per km), a dashed rock-strength limit line, crust/Moho/mantle layers and fracture glow; depthClearer() lets a stage draw the 100 km mesh first, clear depth and then draw a centimetre-scale foreground.
configurable_parameters: PeakCutaway(halfWidth, depth, limitDepth, uReveal, uLimit, uCrack)
assets.notes: Share the atmosphere uniforms object with the sky dome. For street views use worldPerKm ~10 with log depth + depthClearer so angles and haze stay exact; for metre-scale ledges use 1,000 m/km, a hole radius smaller than the local patch, and pick ledge sites with a gentle local slope (steep flanks hide the summit). Keep cameras a few km above heightAt (fine crags reach ~2 km). Geometry is cached per parameter set.

assets.name: Meteor streaks with ionisation trains
assets.description: Deterministic meteors as instanced camera-facing ribbons: a hot white-green head, an orange trail that grows behind it and fades, and a faint green ionisation train that lingers after the head burns out. Explicit spawn list or seeded scatter inside a box; additive, depth-tested.
configurable_parameters: meteors [{at_s, life_s, start, velocity, trail, width, brightness}]
assets.notes: Units are the stage's world units (km in the 80 km shot: trails 7-12 km, widths 35-70 m, ~37 km/s). Spawn in the camera's own frame and in open air: meteors placed inside terrain are depth-hidden.

assets.name: Grounded character acting and straight-path locomotion
assets.description: Opt-in absolute-time planted and seated pose helpers plus distance-driven straight walking for the registered Humanoid rig. Finite action progress supports authored reaches and reactions.
assets.notes: Requires the existing Humanoid shoe dimensions, uniform rig scale and unrotated stage parent. Straight-path stance centers stay fixed; opt-in compensation levels the existing shoe mesh and foot anchor around the ankle. These owned transforms reset on every helper call. No full-body dynamics or curved-path foot locking. Stage owns intent, targets and all pose resets; call hand reachArm after posing.

assets.name: Sun and skylight lighting rig with horizon-clipped sun disc
assets.description: Outdoor light split into physical parts: a shadow-casting sun DirectionalLight scaled by the visible disc fraction, scattered skylight (a visible SkyDome plus its share of a cached PMREM environment bake), sunlit-ground bounce in the bake’s lower hemisphere, and aerial haze (FogExp2 scaled with skylight). A world-space sun disc at true angular size with mild limb darkening and a round in-eye glare sprite is depth-tested, so sea, hills or buildings clip it at the real horizon.
assets.notes: apply() sets the full lighting state every frame from its arguments; environment bakes are cached by quantised sky/ground/sun-direction keys (oldest disposed), so frames are identical after any seek order. Environment provides both sky fill and ground bounce without occlusion: shaded upward-facing ground goes black when skyAmount is 0, vertical surfaces keep some bounce. The disc billboard sits at discDistance; keep it inside the camera far plane. Low suns produce strong grazing specular glare on rough ground: lower exposure or raise roughness rather than adding light.

assets.name: Eruption column, umbrella cloud and pyroclastic flow
assets.description: Sunlit volcanic ash drawn as instanced camera-facing puffs whose centres, sizes and opacity are evaluated on the CPU from absolute time, sorted back-to-front and shaded as soft lit spheres (wrap diffuse from the sun direction, sky ambient, incandescent glow, distance haze). EruptionColumn: a Plinian column rising from a vent to its neutral-buoyancy height with entrainment widening and wind drift, spreading into an umbrella cloud of a given radius. PyroclasticFlow: a ground-hugging avalanche whose front advances along a terrain path, billowing and lifting off behind the front.
assets.notes: Pass the stage camera to update() every frame: puffs are depth-sorted for it. Puffs are large soft billboards, so give distant columns a lighter hazeDensity than the scene fog to keep them dark and readable. Column motion is real-speed (about 95 s to climb), so a short shot shows billowing rather than visible rise.
